text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the mock race started, I overheard 
some Horse Girls chatting—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My lap times haven't improved at all 
lately~.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Same here~. Wonder if today's race is just 
gonna be a bust...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You've just lost sight of your inner 
marvelous☆ But don't you worry!★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I can feel your marvelous loud and clear!☆ 
Let's run a marvelous race together!★

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, where'd that come from all of a 
sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, sorry. I'll take her off your 
hands. Sorry to bother you~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you... You're running in the same 
race as them, right? Why are you giving 
advice to the competition?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted them to realize their 
marvelous!☆ Because that's how you get a 
marvelous race!★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Should I call you tension-free or just 
plain reckless...? Anyway, what about you 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You haven't looked so hot lately... 
Instead of worrying about others, you 
should worry about—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Even when the sun sets, it's still out 
there in space!☆ My marvelous doesn't just 
disappear either!★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So relax and receive the marvelous~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then—under the watchful eyes of a huge 
crowd, the runners burst from the gates 
all at once!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, Marvelous Sunday is currently 
languishing at the back of the pack. How 
will she build her race from here!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oof. Looks like she really isn't in top 
shape. Is she gonna be alright...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha☆ This is where my marvelous 
begins!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—What a move! Marvelous Sunday leaps 
forward! In the blink of an eye, she takes 
the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Reach everyoneee!! —MAAARVELOOOUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She's fast, so incredibly fast, Marvelous 
Sunday! Refusing to give up the lead, she 
claims 1st place at the goooal!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man... pulling off 1st place from way back 
there. Calling it out of the ordinary is 
putting it mildly; that was absurd...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You felt the marvelous too, didn't you, 
Nature?☆ The excitement, the heat, the 
joy☆ It's all marvelous!★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But that's still not enough~☆ I'm gonna 
keep running marvelously from now on too!★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous will reach the ends of the 
earth!☆ I truly believe that!★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ??? I-I see, I guess~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the two Horse Girls whom 
Marvelous Sunday had spoken to before the 
race came over. ...They seemed somewhat 
fired up.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what was that race?! That was 
incredible!! I got swept up in it and gave 
it everything I had!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
How do we run like you? Teach us~!! 
Please, please!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You guys were marvelous right from the 
very start!☆ You just have to accept it 
honestly★ Goals, dreams—visualize 
connecting all the pieces together!☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I really don't think putting it that 
way is gonna get across to them—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*! Deep in my chest, it's burning...! 
Is this what marvelous is!?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: I feel it too! Marvelous! Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's☆Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Ahahaha. Well then, I'll leave the 
rest to you youngsters...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
One's own marvelous, huh... If that really 
makes you run faster, maybe I should—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nature, you noticed your marvelous too! 
Welcome to the marvelous world!☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: D-Daaarn it aaaaallll!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the two Horse Girls whom 
Marvelous Sunday had spoken to before the 
race came over.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...You were so fast. I've never seen 
running like that before.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after your back helped me run 
pretty decently too... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That sensation right there is marvelous!☆ 
Make sure to save that memory!★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My, aren't you all so deeply 
impressionable—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Well, not that I wasn't moved a bit 
myself, though.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Really, really!? Then let's become 
marvelous together too, Nature!☆
